name: Austin
summary: Austin is Texas's laid-back capital and the 'Live Music Capital of the World'. Eat brisket at legendary smokehouses, swim at Barton Springs, watch 1.5 million bats leave the Congress Avenue Bridge and hear bands on Sixth Street.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn are pleasant; summer is very hot. SXSW (March) and ACL Fest (October) fill hotels.
cashTip: Cards and tap work almost everywhere. Tip 18-22% at restaurants and a dollar or two per drink at bars.
buyTip: Cowboy boots and local art on South Congress.
